description: This Java source file defines the BenchTestPane class which constructs a GUI panel with various button controls for testing different vehicle components like fuel pump, spark, MIL, etc., by sending specific commands to hardware or a backend system.

classes.name: BenchTestPane
classes.description: A GUI panel class that provides controls for executing various engine component tests including fan, fuel pump, spark, injector, MIL, idle, and dizzy.

methods.name: BenchTestPane
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel with different testing components.

methods.name: createMILTest
methods.description: Creates a control component for testing the MIL (check engine light).

methods.name: createIdleTest
methods.description: Creates a control component for testing the Idle Valve.

methods.name: createDizzyTest
methods.description: Creates a control component for testing the distributor (dizzy).

methods.name: createFanTest
methods.description: Creates a control component for testing the radiator fan.

methods.name: createFuelPumpTest
methods.description: Creates a control component for testing the fuel pump.

methods.name: createSparkTest
methods.description: Creates a control component for testing spark with selectable spark index.

methods.name: createInjectorTest
methods.description: Creates a control component for testing injector with selectable injector index.

methods.name: createIndexCombo
methods.description: Helper method to create a JComboBox with indices from 1 to 12 for selection in tests.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing all test controls.
